boundaries.behavior_focus: runtime-facing lowering contracts, ABI metadata, and optimization-invariant behavior

boundaries.behavior_focus: textual interface emission, module metadata preservation, and verifier drift diagnostics
boundaries.hard_cutover_rule: round-trip fixtures preserve canonical metadata and reject missing or downgraded metadata rather than accepting compatibility drift

boundaries.hard_cutover_rule: diagnostic fixtures are the canonical home for retired spelling, removed flag, and unsupported feature rejection expectations
